title: AgentSchema

memory_blocks.title: Memory Blocks
memory_blocks.description: The blocks to create in the agent's in-context memory.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: The tools used by the agent.

tool_ids.title: Tool Ids
tool_ids.description: The ids of the tools used by the agent.

source_ids.title: Source Ids
source_ids.description: The ids of the sources used by the agent.

folder_ids.title: Folder Ids
folder_ids.description: The ids of the folders used by the agent.

block_ids.title: Block Ids
block_ids.description: The ids of the blocks used by the agent.

tool_rules.title: Tool Rules
tool_rules.description: The tool rules governing the agent.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: The tags associated with the agent.

system.title: System
system.description: The system prompt used by the agent.

initial_message_sequence.title: Initial Message Sequence
initial_message_sequence.description: The initial set of messages to put in the agent's in-context memory.

include_base_tools.title: Include Base Tools
include_base_tools.description: If true, attaches the Letta core tools (e.g. core_memory related functions).

include_multi_agent_tools.title: Include Multi Agent Tools
include_multi_agent_tools.description: If true, attaches the Letta multi-agent tools (e.g. sending a message to another agent).

include_base_tool_rules.title: Include Base Tool Rules
include_base_tool_rules.description: If true, attaches the Letta base tool rules (e.g. deny all tools not explicitly allowed).

include_default_source.title: Include Default Source
include_default_source.description: If true, automatically creates and attaches a default data source for this agent.

llm_config.description: Deprecated: Use `model` field instead. The LLM configuration used by the agent.

embedding_config.description: Deprecated: Use `embedding` field instead. The embedding configuration used by the agent.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model handle for the agent to use (format: provider/model-name).

embedding.title: Embedding
embedding.description: The embedding model handle used by the agent (format: provider/model-name).

model_settings.title: Model Settings
model_settings.description: The model settings for the agent.

compaction_settings.description: The compaction settings configuration used for compaction.

context_window_limit.title: Context Window Limit
context_window_limit.description: The context window limit used by the agent.

embedding_chunk_size.title: Embedding Chunk Size
embedding_chunk_size.description: Deprecated: No longer used. The embedding chunk size used by the agent.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: Deprecated: Use `model` field to configure max output tokens instead. The maximum number of tokens to generate, including reasoning step.

max_reasoning_tokens.title: Max Reasoning Tokens
max_reasoning_tokens.description: Deprecated: Use `model` field to configure reasoning tokens instead. The maximum number of tokens to generate for reasoning step.

enable_reasoner.title: Enable Reasoner
enable_reasoner.description: Deprecated: Use `model` field to configure reasoning instead. Whether to enable internal extended thinking step for a reasoner model.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Deprecated: Use `model` field to configure reasoning instead. Whether to enable reasoning for this agent.

from_template.title: From Template
from_template.description: Deprecated: please use the 'create agents from a template' endpoint instead.

project.title: Project
project.description: Deprecated: Project should now be passed via the X-Project header instead of in the request body. If using the SDK, this can be done via the x_project parameter.

tool_exec_environment_variables.title: Tool Exec Environment Variables
tool_exec_environment_variables.description: Deprecated: Use `secrets` field instead. Environment variables for tool execution.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.description: The environment variables for tool execution specific to this agent.

memory_variables.title: Memory Variables
memory_variables.description: Deprecated: Only relevant for creating agents from a template. Use the 'create agents from a template' endpoint instead.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Deprecated: No longer used. The id of the project the agent belongs to.

template_id.title: Template Id
template_id.description: Deprecated: No longer used. The id of the template the agent belongs to.

base_template_id.title: Base Template Id
base_template_id.description: Deprecated: No longer used. The base template id of the agent.

identity_ids.title: Identity Ids
identity_ids.description: The ids of the identities associated with this agent.

message_buffer_autoclear.title: Message Buffer Autoclear
message_buffer_autoclear.description: If set to True, the agent will not remember previous messages (though the agent will still retain state via core memory blocks and archival/recall memory). Not recommended unless you have an advanced use case.

enable_sleeptime.title: Enable Sleeptime
enable_sleeptime.description: If set to True, memory management will move to a background agent thread.

response_format.title: Response Format
response_format.description: Deprecated: Use `model_settings` field to configure response format instead. The response format for the agent.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: The timezone of the agent (IANA format).

max_files_open.title: Max Files Open
max_files_open.description: Maximum number of files that can be open at once for this agent. Setting this too high may exceed the context window, which will break the agent.

per_file_view_window_char_limit.title: Per File View Window Char Limit
per_file_view_window_char_limit.description: The per-file view window character limit for this agent. Setting this too high may exceed the context window, which will break the agent.

hidden.title: Hidden
hidden.description: Deprecated: No longer used. If set to True, the agent will be hidden.

parallel_tool_calls.title: Parallel Tool Calls
parallel_tool_calls.description: Deprecated: Use `model_settings` to configure parallel tool calls instead. If set to True, enables parallel tool calling.

id.title: Id
id.description: Human-readable identifier for this agent in the file

in_context_message_ids.title: In Context Message Ids
in_context_message_ids.description: List of message IDs that are currently in the agent's context

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: List of messages in the agent's conversation history

files_agents.title: Files Agents
files_agents.description: List of file-agent relationships for this agent

group_ids.title: Group Ids
group_ids.description: List of groups that the agent manages

description: Agent with human-readable ID for agent file
